acceptance.check: README setup/run instructions must be executable and supported by pyproject/source; do not claim start.command exists in this snapshot; accurately state Python >=3.11 and Orca/Codex prerequisites.

Document the four required variables DISCORD_TOKEN, DISCORD_GUILD_ID, DISCORD_USER_ID, CODEX_CHANNEL_ID; ORCA_BINARY default orca; ORCA_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS default 300000 and minimum 1000; STATE_PATH default .state.json with ~ expansion; .env is loaded.

Explain ordinary replies use Orca structured agent state for the exact worktree and pane binding, not TUI screen parsing; only assistant message content is surfaced and tool details are omitted; require Orca to expose the Codex agent row.

Accurately state the configured guild/user/channel filters for ordinary messages and guild/user checks for slash interactions; no claim of an OS/VM sandbox or broader security property unsupported by source.
Clearly state there is no GitHub API integration or webhook receiver; an existing webhook embed may be forwarded as Discord message content only if that behavior is described accurately.
Document Discord // prefix mapping; /clear, /compact, /new are sent and acknowledged without ordinary screen parsing; /status is the narrow screen-read exception; normal prompts do not screen-scrape.
Only README.md changes; no source/tests/dependencies or unrelated docs changed.
